propositions: Link-sync unit tests exercise only single-representative relations (blocks ~19×; depends_on 0×) leaving other relation types uncovered and masking direction swap bugs like c8ed

The link-dedup emission test must parametrize over all six relations: mapped ones (blocks/depends_on/relates_to) assert exact type and swap tuple; unmapped ones (duplicates/supersedes/discovered_from) assert empty mutation list
The link-removal sync test lacks coverage for the outbound Blocks→depends_on remove path (untested branch at outbound_links.py:193-202) and must assert remove action with depends_on relation
Test assertions must validate per-relation orientation (swap: True/False) and swapped endpoint tuples, not merely link presence, to catch regressions like c8ed
No production source code changes are made; this is test-only hardening to close sibling test gaps across the link-sync seam
